description: This file defines the CliLoggerFormatter class, which implements a custom log formatter for CLI output, including color coding and message formatting for different log levels.

classes.name: CliLoggerFormatter
classes.description: A formatter class for CLI logging that adds color and formatting based on log levels.

methods.name: __construct
methods.description: Initializes color codes and log message format.

methods.name: formatBatch
methods.description: Formats a batch of log records.

methods.name: format
methods.description: Formats a single log record with color coding and message formatting.

methods.name: getColors
methods.description: Returns an array of color codes for terminal output.

methods.name: code
methods.description: Generates terminal escape sequences for color codes.

methods.name: getColourAndCode
methods.description: Determines color and symbol based on log level.
